method: corpus-blind controlled generator; 38 practical/natural/physical cross-domain cases

cases.knowledge_need: How to stop rainwater entering through a lifted birch-bark roof overlap without trapping moisture in the timber below.
cases.circumstances: steady rain follows two windy days
cases.situation: Bedding beneath one eave is becoming wet before night.

cases.knowledge_need: How water temperature and rubbing affect wool fleece being washed of grease and dirt.
cases.circumstances: spring water is cold while one pail was heated
cases.situation: She needs clean fiber that remains loose enough to spin.

cases.knowledge_need: Why a damp clay pot should not be put directly beside a strong fire after a small crack is patched.
cases.circumstances: a cooking pot cracked while being washed
cases.situation: Supper is near, but the repair must not turn into a larger break.

cases.knowledge_need: How to keep a pot of peas from scorching when its liquid cooks down over uneven hearth heat.
cases.circumstances: the firewood includes both dry sticks and damp billets
cases.situation: The meal must stretch until field workers return.

cases.knowledge_need: How warmth and unwashed vessels affect fresh milk souring before it can be made into curds.
cases.circumstances: milking ended late on a hot day
cases.situation: She needs to save food for children before evening.

cases.knowledge_need: How to brace a leaning temporary wall while replacing a rotten lower sill.
cases.circumstances: spring thaw has softened the ground beneath the corner
cases.situation: The roof load remains above the damaged timber.

cases.knowledge_need: How wind direction and dry thatch affect safe repair near an open cooking fire.
cases.circumstances: loose straw hangs over the low side of the roof
cases.situation: He must secure it before a forecast gale without starting a roof fire.

cases.knowledge_need: How to detect when a wet leather collar is rubbing a horse's shoulder and should be adjusted before a long haul.
cases.circumstances: wet snow has soaked the harness
cases.situation: The loaded cart still has several miles of rough road.

cases.knowledge_need: How thawed snow and frozen ruts change the effort and control needed to pull a loaded sledge downhill.
cases.circumstances: afternoon thaw has glazed the morning's deep ruts
cases.situation: He must keep the load from running into the draft animal.

cases.knowledge_need: How to assess a ford when muddy water hides holes and current pushes against a person's legs.
cases.circumstances: rain upstream has raised the water since morning
cases.situation: She carries dry cloth and cannot afford a dangerous crossing.

cases.knowledge_need: How to lower a bucket when a worn well rope has rough fibers and the curb is slick with ice.
cases.circumstances: a hard frost followed a day of thaw
cases.situation: He needs water without dropping the bucket or falling against the curb.

cases.knowledge_need: How runoff from a nearby animal yard can make clear-looking surface water unsuitable for drinking.
cases.circumstances: heavy rain has cut channels through the slope
cases.situation: The flock and two children need water before reaching the next well.

cases.knowledge_need: How to dry wet socks and boots near a hearth without burning leather or leaving feet exposed to cold.
cases.circumstances: he stepped through slush at dusk
cases.situation: He must be able to walk home safely at dawn.

cases.knowledge_need: How numb pale fingers after wind exposure differ from hands merely chilled by cold water.
cases.circumstances: strong wind blows through wet gloves
cases.situation: She must decide whether to stop work and warm her hands.

cases.knowledge_need: How dizziness and weakness after hours in direct sun can be worsened by continued exertion and lack of water.
cases.circumstances: the day is still and unusually hot
cases.situation: A companion wants him to finish one more cartload.

cases.knowledge_need: How to protect a deep splinter wound from dirt while deciding whether the embedded fragment can be safely removed.
cases.circumstances: a fresh board tore against his palm
cases.situation: He must avoid making the hand worse before seeking help.

cases.knowledge_need: How wick length, fuel level, and a moving draft affect an oil lamp's flame and smoke.
cases.circumstances: the lamp dims whenever the hatch opens
cases.situation: He must inspect sacks without setting dry chaff alight.

cases.knowledge_need: How to keep a tallow candle from igniting nearby flax fibers when work must continue after dark.
cases.circumstances: the only table is crowded with loose fiber
cases.situation: She needs light to finish a repair without creating a fire hazard.

cases.knowledge_need: How a blocked flue and changing outside wind can force smoke back into a one-room house.
cases.circumstances: smoke thickens after fresh fuel is added
cases.situation: An infant sleeps inside and the meal is unfinished.

cases.knowledge_need: How ash lye can burn skin and damage cloth when used for washing.
cases.circumstances: a pail was knocked over beside rinsed linen
cases.situation: She must protect hands and separate the affected cloth.

cases.knowledge_need: How warmth, headspace, and a sealed lid affect pressure in fermenting cabbage brine.
cases.circumstances: a warm spell follows a hard freeze
cases.situation: One vessel is hissing around its cover and food must not be wasted.

cases.knowledge_need: How water added to quicklime can produce heat and caustic splashes.
cases.circumstances: he is preparing whitewash beside stored tools
cases.situation: He needs usable lime without injuring himself or spoiling nearby wood.

cases.knowledge_need: How to use a lever and firm fulcrum to shift a stone without the lever slipping toward feet.
cases.circumstances: the stone sits partly sunk in wet ground
cases.situation: He must move it before a plough team arrives.

cases.knowledge_need: How friction over a wooden edge and shock loading can weaken a rope used to lower a heavy chest.
cases.circumstances: the chest must pass through a narrow hatch
cases.situation: People below need it lowered without a sudden drop.

cases.knowledge_need: How a loose belt or water-driven shaft can pull clothing into moving machinery.
cases.circumstances: meal has begun spilling beside the turning stones
cases.situation: He wants to clear the blockage without reaching into a dangerous mechanism.

cases.knowledge_need: How aphids and ants on bean shoots affect new growth and when damaged shoots should be inspected.
cases.circumstances: curled leaves appeared after several warm dry days
cases.situation: She wants to protect the crop without harming useful insects nearby.

cases.knowledge_need: How air, moisture, and compacted plant waste affect odor and decomposition in a garden heap.
cases.circumstances: the heap is wet outside but dry and sour-smelling within
cases.situation: He needs material that will improve soil next season.

cases.knowledge_need: How to react when a startled cow with a calf blocks a narrow path.
cases.circumstances: a dog barked from behind the hedge
cases.situation: She must pass without provoking the animal or being trapped against the fence.

cases.knowledge_need: How to avoid worsening a bee sting when more bees remain agitated near a disturbed hive.
cases.circumstances: a branch fell across a hive entrance
cases.situation: He has been stung and must get clear before helping further.

cases.knowledge_need: How to choose safer shelter during nearby thunder when open ground, tall trees, and a low building are all close.
cases.circumstances: thunder follows visible lightning within moments
cases.situation: Workers carry metal tools and need to stop before rain reaches them.

cases.knowledge_need: How to secure shutters and loose yard objects before a windstorm without standing beneath unstable branches.
cases.circumstances: gusts are already breaking small twigs
cases.situation: A window faces the wind and children are inside.

cases.knowledge_need: How rapidly rising water changes the safety of a low footbridge and its supporting banks.
cases.circumstances: rain has continued since the previous night
cases.situation: He must decide whether to cross before the boat is moved away.

cases.knowledge_need: How snow cover can hide weak ice over a current near a riverbank.
cases.circumstances: fresh snow covers yesterday's track
cases.situation: He wants to retrieve a line without breaking through.

cases.knowledge_need: How humidity and smoke affect fish hung to dry in a shed.
cases.circumstances: fog has lasted for two days and the fire smolders
cases.situation: She must prevent the catch from spoiling before market day.

cases.knowledge_need: How condensation in a sealed grain chest can lead to damp clumps and mold after a temperature swing.
cases.circumstances: a thaw followed several freezing nights
cases.situation: Seed grain must remain sound until planting.

cases.knowledge_need: How keeping firewood raised off wet ground changes drying and rot risk.
cases.circumstances: the woodpile has slumped into autumn mud
cases.situation: Winter fuel must dry enough to burn with less smoke.

cases.knowledge_need: How moisture and soil left on an iron hoe accelerate rust and make the edge harder to use.
cases.circumstances: work ended in rain and the tool was left overnight
cases.situation: He needs it ready for planting the next morning.

cases.knowledge_need: How to avoid confusing edible spring greens with irritating or poisonous look-alikes when gathering near a ditch.
cases.circumstances: new leaves are emerging among last year's dead stems
cases.situation: She needs greens for supper but cannot risk feeding an unsafe plant to her family.
